pages.text: ParCool adds a special animation of jump: $(bold)Flipping$().$(br2) You can do front-flip and back-flip.

pages.title: How to Use
pages.text: $(list)Tap a movement key, then jump right away$(list)Forward key gives a front-flip, back key gives a back-flip$(br)The Flipping key($(k:parcool.Flipping)) does nothing with this control setting
$(bold)Turn On / Off$()$(br2)You can turn this action on or off right here.
